subject.title: [Bug]: browser upload/file chooser flow is flaky and can misreport stale-click failures as browser control timeouts

question: Should OpenClaw make atomic upload+trigger the preferred browser upload flow for dynamic pages, or keep `upload(paths)` as a separate arming primitive with guidance only?
rationale: Current code supports both split arming and atomic ref-trigger upload, and choosing the default model-facing behavior affects tool semantics rather than a purely mechanical bug fix.

options.title: Prefer atomic upload guidance
options.body: Keep the route API compatible but update the tool/schema/docs and tests so agents are steered to pass `ref` when a chooser trigger is known.

options.title: Change runtime defaults
options.body: Make upload without a trigger ref warn or fail in chooser-trigger contexts, accepting a stronger behavior change for existing workflows.

options.title: Leave current semantics
options.body: Keep the current split and atomic API behavior, and require live repro evidence before changing browser upload guidance.

recommendation.title: Prefer atomic upload guidance
recommendation.body: Keep the route API compatible but update the tool/schema/docs and tests so agents are steered to pass `ref` when a chooser trigger is known.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent browser route and client history makes this account the best available owner for the behavior choice.
